content: JESUS EḎUA HIBAIṮOM
Aria Juda dilag Meṯid uḵa male, buṯuanab amu ah ag ahan moḏp̱a gop̱ig. Ag goḏen muṯuḏig ena ele babaiṯeg dayom, amu ele aḵan gop̱ig.
Ag gona, men naḏi moḏ ameg tonom amu laa nug duṯune uḵa, moḏ amegp̱a ii daye anidna,
ag moḏ oop̱a nop̱ig amge Naḏi Jesus gaḏa amu ag ii anidp̱ig.
Ii anidna, ag amunu dab mak kuḏum aona, ootot aqe henana amu ag danab aḏit miag hip̱aidya daaeheh anatp̱ig, ahilah lamen amu haḵab diṯiag apinak ele.
Anidna, ah ag baḏan, wanp̱a dup nop̱ig amge danab aḏit a ag amelagp̱a apiḏ. “Aḏinu ag danab bau am ag mauhak gaḏalag maadṯeb abenp̱a maṯin oiṯeb? Nug ip̱a iiṯa. Nug eḏua hibaiṯom,” aoya apiḏ.
A anam ayaya amu amelagp̱a nai tuḏidya apiḏ. “Nai imu haen Nug Galelia dayaya, ag amelagp̱a maṯiom amu, ag daulagp̱a doaḏ!

Nug ag amelagp̱a inam awa aum. ‘Ag amu Danab Beḵalag da, da aḏailna, iiṯa aḏi danab ep̱elagp̱a meiḏp̱eg, ag amu da ad emaitakp̱a atuliḏp̱eg amu geha deḏ ewamp̱a Kayak Nug heeb, da eḏue hip̱aidḵul,’ awa aum,” aoya apiḏ.
Aria ag Jesus Nug nai amu anuḵa amelagp̱a aum amunu dab mep̱ig.
Aaḵu moḏp̱a daap̱ig amu ag uun, eḏun gona, ip̱uniṯak awak danab elewen amu amelagp̱a awona amu danab laala ele amelagp̱a ag keeke oh anidp̱ig, amunu madip̱ig.
Maria, Magdala ted, Joana amu Maria, Jakobus anig, aria ah laala ag ele ag nai amu ip̱uniṯak awak danab amelagp̱a madip̱ig.
Ah ag nai amu amelagp̱a madip̱ig amge ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag ahilag dab makp̱a, “Ah ag nai ulah hamu madiṯeb,” aon anana, ag nai maṯieg doop̱ig amunu oolagp̱a genab ii doop̱ig.
Oolagp̱a genab ii doop̱ig amge Petrus nug aha, qaibaḏ moḏp̱a uḵa, gomela, moḏ oop̱a neeḵe no amu linen lamenib dayeye anṯowa amu nug eḏua uḵa, keeke amunu dab mak kuḏum awom.
DANAB AḎIT EMAUS IBP̱A JESUS ANIDPIḎ
Amu deḏ amup̱aib ag oolagp̱a danab aḏit a ab nakok onig Emaus ap̱a gopiḏ. Ib Jerusalemnu aha Emaus uḵak amu 11 kilomita anam.
A goyaya amu a keeke oh Jerusalem ap̱a hep̱ig amunu madipiḏ.
A amu maṯiiya, nug oḏ meṯaiya uḵaeheh, Jesus Nug tula do, a ele oh gop̱ig.
Ag oh gop̱ig amge a Nug am Jesus a ii doopiḏ. Aḏinu? A amelah ii op̱atom.
Amunu Nug a oḏ mata, amelahp̱a aum. “A amu aḏi keekenu nai maṯiya goṯep?” Anam awa a amu danab aḏit amu oolahp̱a elele ii dooya, iḏulah nauhe, hip̱aidya daapiḏ.

Anam daaiya, danab onig Kliopas nug aha amegp̱a aum. “Amu danab ab laih laihnu oh ag gemu Jerusalem daaṯeb amu ag oolagp̱a na naḵa aḵuibtai keeke oh haen imup̱a Jerusalem beum am iite dooṯem?” awa aum.

Nug anam awa a amu Jesus Nug a oḏ matom. “Aḏi keeke?” Awa a amu aria a Nug amegp̱a kobol oh Jesusnu hep̱ig amu maṯiya inam apiḏ. “Jesus, Nasaret ted, Nug amu Kayaknu propet, Nug Kayak nai diig genab g̱agaṯag ele Kayak noobp̱a danab ah amelagp̱a ele maṯia mehuqaqa, uḏat g̱agaṯag ele haaha oiyom.
Amu mana meṯak danab oḵai, amu ihinḵad iḵi danab ele ag aon, gabman ep̱elagp̱a mena, qep̱eg mauhḵunu aeg, gabman ag nug ad emaitakp̱a atulp̱ig.
Amge ig nuhignu amu genab doomut, Nug amu Israel dilag eḏua awiḵak danab. Ag anam heeg uḏie, gemu am deḏ ewam iiḵu.
Amu laa ele amu gemu ig oonigp̱an ah laala, ag heeg ig oṯaimut. Ag buṯuanab ahan moḏp̱a gop̱ig
amge ag Jesus gaḏa ii anidp̱ig. Ii anidna amu ag eḏun uḏin, ag engel aḏit anategeg, ‘Jesus Nug bau daaṯe,’ apiḏ amu aeg doomut.
Ag anam aeg amu ig oonigp̱an danab laala ag moḏp̱a gona, keeke ah ag ap̱ig ele amuib anidp̱ig amge Nug amu ag ii anidp̱ig,” aoya apiḏ.
Anam aeh, Jesus Nug amelahp̱a aum. “A danab dab mak iiṯa ele. Kayaknu propet dilag nai amu mehuqp̱ig amge a oolahp̱a amu a genab ii doopiḏ,” awa aum.
Nug anam anana, Nug a amelahp̱a nai tuḏiṯa aum. “Kristus Nug guiṯak awa, amup̱a anuqak abenp̱a daaḵu amu propet laa nug Kayak oḏe awa iite yom?” awa aum.
Nug anam amelahp̱a awowa, Nug Mosesnu naip̱a dig me uḵe, Kayaknu propet oh dilag nai amu amelahp̱a mehuqom. Nug Kayak nai yak oop̱a nuhignu nai aum niiṯe amu oh diig mehuqom.
Nug mehuqeqe, ag gona, ab a gopiḏ ele amu guḵuidnana, Jesus Nug anam haaha, uuata goḵunu heum
amge a Nug hagaḵa aoya apiḏ. “Na i ele daatu! Aam no, uu doumde!” Anam aeh, amu Nug lag oop̱a no, oh daap̱ig.
Daanna dimp̱a e laḵulagnu hena, Jesus Nug ele oh daanna, Nug bret awa, Kayak unuqiṯa, pane ne, Nug matete,
a amelah op̱ate, a Nug amu Jesus anidya doyeheh, Nug uḵom. Uḵe, a Nug baula ii anidya
amu aya aya inam apiḏ. “I ibp̱a uḏiuḏuḏ, Nug Kayak nai meu tutuḵu mehuqe doomuḏ amu i oonihp̱a nuhig nai meu elenab iite doomuḏ?” aoya apiḏ.
A anam ayaya, a deḏ amup̱aib ahaya, eḏuya Jerusalem goya, ip̱uniṯak awak danab elewen ap̱a daap̱ig amu laala ele ag qag mena daaegeg anadpiḏ.
Anaṯeh amu ag a amelahp̱a ap̱ig. “Genabnab, Naḏi Nug eḏua hibaiṯom, Simon nug anṯom,” aon ap̱ig.
Ag anam aeg amu danab aḏit a ibp̱a keeke oh be anidpiḏ amunu maṯiya amu tuḏidya apiḏ. “Nug Kayak unuqiṯa, bret pana mete, i nug anidḏa, aaḵu i Nug doomuḏ,” aoya apiḏ.
IP̱UNIṮAK AWAK DANAB AG JESUS ANIDP̱IG
Ip̱uniṯak awak danab amu danab laala ele ag nuhignu aaḵu maṯinna daaegeg, Jesus Nug nuḵa tula doa, oolagp̱a hibaiṯa, amelagp̱a aum. “Ag oo mak, maḏoḏ ele dayeg!” awa aum.
Nug anam a, ag oṯaina, baḏan ag dab makp̱a ap̱ig. “Ig doṯog laa anidṯem,” ap̱ig.
Amge Nug ag amelagp̱a aum. “Ag aḏinu oṯaina oolagp̱a dab mak laala aoṯeb?
Ag da ep̱el bael ele iiḵud anṯeg! Daib iiḵu daaṯem. Ag ep̱elag bahina aḏailna anṯeg! Doṯog nug beḏu, ebehi ele iiṯa, ag da aniḏṯeb bia,” awa aum.
Nug anam anana amu Nug ep̱eg baeg ele ip̱uanaṯom.
Ag Nug anidna, ag oolag gamag huan ahom amunu ag oolagp̱a genab ii doop̱ig, ahilag dab mak piḏe piḏe ele anaṯa amu amelagp̱a aum. “Ag e laa ana daaṯete?” awa oḏ maṯom.
A amu ag kakai laih maip̱ig amu aon meṯaeg,
Nug aḏa lanana anṯegeg,
Nug amelagp̱a aum. “Anuḵa da ag ele daatta ag amelagp̱a dahilnu nai oh Mosesnu ḏop̱a amu Kayaknu propet dilag yakp̱a ele nai amu oh beḵununab ami amu aaḵu meu beum,” awa aum.
Nug anam anana, Nug nai yak amu oolagp̱a tutuḵunab genab maiṯeb dooglagnu ip̱uanaṯaṯa,
amelagp̱a aum. “Kayaknu yak inam ip̱unigṯe. Kristus Nug guiṯak awowa amu deḏ ewamp̱a nug eḏua hip̱aidḵu.

Amu danab ag oolag eḏuḵunu amu ag hip̱unin uhuqa meṯak aoglagnu, laala ag Nug onigp̱a nai amu danab buḏub ohnu oolagp̱a mehuqp̱ep̱eg dooglag. Ag uḏat amu Jerusalem dig meḵulag. Kayak nai anam ip̱unigṯe.
Amu ag gemu da ele iiḵu daaṯem amu ag dahilp̱a keeke oh anidp̱ig,” awa aum.

Jesus Nug anam anana, Nug baula tuḏiṯa aum. “Doyeg! Da Mamel Nug keeke amu anuḵa ag madaḵunu nai qaḵa aum amu da hep̱i neḵu amge ag ab oḵaip̱a daap̱eg, hab aṯannu g̱agaṯag amu ahilagp̱a neeb, ag uḏat dig meḵulag,” awa aum.
Nug anam awowa, Nug aha, diie gona, Betani ap̱a Nug ep̱eg huma itaṯom.
Nug itaṯeṯe amu Kayak awe, nug uuaṯe, hab aṯan uḵom.
Nug anam he, ag oolag gamag ahak naḏi ele Nug binag mena, ag eḏun Jerusalem gop̱ig.
Gona ag hanhan mana meṯak laḵa daanna, ag Kayak binag menan daadṯp̱ig.
